title: Ride a Segway around Maungauika / North Head
description: Glide around the summit and coastal fortifications on a guided Segway tour, then dismount to explore the tunnels, bunkers and disappearing gun while hearing the reserve's defence history.

title: Ride a seascooter over the Cloud 9 coral garden
description: Use a powered underwater scooter to skim above the shallow coral garden beside Cloud 9, with a shore briefing, reef shoes, mask, snorkel and optional life vest included.

title: Explore the thatched houses of Gero Onsen Gassho Village
description: Walk through an open-air settlement of ten relocated gassho-zukuri houses, including the important Odo House, with displays on Hida rural life, traditional crafts and forested hillside paths.
